Welcome to 2026 Seoul Particle Theory Workshop. The workshop aims to bring together a mix of theorists working on all aspects of beyond the standard model physics, as well as experimentalists. We plan a relaxed program with ample time for discussions.

Optional Excursions: 2026 Seoul Jazz Festival

If you want to join with us for the jazz festoval, you need to purchase the ticket for the festival on your own. We recommend you to buy it as early as possible, as the ticket will be all sold out as the even dates approaches.
